title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - ConfidentialComputing
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/ConfidentialComputing. Class representing confidential computing capabilities within the Gaia-X service characteristics framework.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ConfidentialComputing'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

technology.description: Property. Particular confidential computing technology used by flavors.

attestationServiceURI.description: Property. Indicates whether the confidential server has an associated attestation service, and its URI.
